info.name: enable-goal-search API
info.description: Pruebas de GET /v1/goals y GET /v1/goals/{goalId}/plants contra el servicio local de docker compose. Variables: baseUrl y token (secreta).

exec: pm.test("cumple el esquema de backend/openapi.json", () => pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema(schema));

pm.test("array en la raiz con los seis objetivos en orden", () => { pm.expect(j).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(j.map(g => g.id)).to.eql(["relajacion-estres","mejorar-el-sueno","cuidado-de-la-piel","alivio-respiratorio","cansancio-y-fatiga","otros-objetivos"]); });

pm.test("nombres en espanol", () => pm.expect(j.map(g => g.name)).to.eql(["Relajación / Estrés","Mejorar el sueño","Cuidado de la piel","Alivio respiratorio","Cansancio y fatiga","Otros objetivos"]));
pm.test("solo otros-objetivos trae subareas, las demas []", () => j.forEach(g => pm.expect(g.subareas.length > 0).to.eql(g.id === "otros-objetivos")));

pm.test("subareas en orden con conteos 68, 42, 22, 20, 17, 1", () => { const s = j[5].subareas; pm.expect(s.map(x => x.id)).to.eql(["digestion","vias-urinarias-y-genitales","dolor-e-inflamacion","boca-y-garganta","circulacion","molestias-oculares"]); pm.expect(s.map(x => x.plantCount)).to.eql([68,42,22,20,17,1]); });
pm.test("cumple el esquema de backend/openapi.json", () => pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema(schema));

pm.test("goal, subarea null, total 8, limit 20, offset 0", () => { pm.expect(j.goal).to.eql({id: "mejorar-el-sueno", name: "Mejorar el sueño"}); pm.expect(j.subarea).to.eql(null); pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(8); pm.expect(j.limit).to.eql(20); pm.expect(j.offset).to.eql(0); pm.expect(j.items.length).to.eql(8); });

pm.test("campos de cada planta y nada de dosis ni descripcion", () => j.items.forEach(i => pm.expect(Object.keys(i).sort()).to.eql(["areas","commonNames","displayName","family","hasSafety","id","image","safetyLevel","scientificName"])));

pm.test("orden por displayName normalizado, cientifico normalizado e id", () => { const k = i => [norm(i.displayName), norm(i.scientificName), i.id]; const cmp = (a, b) => { for (let n = 0; n < 3; n++) { if (a[n] < b[n]) return -1; if (a[n] > b[n]) return 1; } return 0; }; const ks = j.items.map(k); for (let n = 1; n < ks.length; n++) pm.expect(cmp(ks[n-1], ks[n]), `${ks[n-1]} vs ${ks[n]}`).to.be.below(1); });
pm.test("areas sin lenguaje de dosis o eficacia", () => j.items.forEach(i => i.areas.forEach(a => pm.expect(a).to.not.match(/dosis|\bmg\b|eficaz|eficacia|efecto|calma|ayuda a|promueve|reduce/i))));
pm.test("cumple el esquema de backend/openapi.json", () => pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema(schema));
pm.test("total 17 y el hiperico ausente", () => { pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(17); pm.expect(j.items.map(i => i.id)).to.not.include("hypericum-perforatum"); });

pm.test("orden por displayName normalizado, cientifico normalizado e id", () => { const k = i => [norm(i.displayName), norm(i.scientificName), i.id]; const cmp = (a, b) => { for (let n = 0; n < 3; n++) { if (a[n] < b[n]) return -1; if (a[n] > b[n]) return 1; } return 0; }; const ks = j.items.map(k); for (let n = 1; n < ks.length; n++) pm.expect(cmp(ks[n-1], ks[n]), `${ks[n-1]} vs ${ks[n]}`).to.be.below(1); });
pm.test("cumple el esquema de backend/openapi.json", () => pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema(schema));
pm.test("subarea digestion, total 68", () => { pm.expect(j.subarea).to.eql({id: "digestion", name: "Digestión"}); pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(68); pm.expect(j.items.length).to.eql(68); });

pm.test("areas de digestion solamente", () => { const ok = new Set(["Trastornos gastrointestinales","Estreñimiento","Pérdida de apetito","Pérdida de apetito; Trastornos gastrointestinales","Estreñimiento; Trastornos gastrointestinales","Trastornos gastrointestinales; Trastornos digestivos"]); j.items.forEach(i => i.areas.forEach(a => pm.expect(ok.has(a), a).to.eql(true))); });

pm.test("orden por displayName normalizado, cientifico normalizado e id", () => { const k = i => [norm(i.displayName), norm(i.scientificName), i.id]; const cmp = (a, b) => { for (let n = 0; n < 3; n++) { if (a[n] < b[n]) return -1; if (a[n] > b[n]) return 1; } return 0; }; const ks = j.items.map(k); for (let n = 1; n < ks.length; n++) pm.expect(cmp(ks[n-1], ks[n]), `${ks[n-1]} vs ${ks[n]}`).to.be.below(1); });
pm.test("areas sin lenguaje de dosis o eficacia", () => j.items.forEach(i => i.areas.forEach(a => pm.expect(a).to.not.match(/dosis|\bmg\b|eficaz|eficacia|efecto|calma|ayuda a|promueve|reduce/i))));

pm.test("cinco elementos, limit 5, offset 5, total 52", () => { pm.expect(j.items.length).to.eql(5); pm.expect(j.limit).to.eql(5); pm.expect(j.offset).to.eql(5); pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(52); });
